risk_title: Excessive privileged access in production systems
business_impact: Unauthorised access could lead to data exposure system misuse or audit failure
control_objective: Ensure privileged access is approved reviewed and limited to business need
evidence_required: Access review export approval record and removed access evidence
review_notes: Shows privileged users and review date but requires clearer approval record
remediation_action: Remove unnecessary privileged access and document approval for remaining admin users
closure_evidence_required: Updated access review export and approval record

risk_title: Incomplete logging for critical cloud activities
business_impact: Security events may not be detected investigated or evidenced during audit
control_objective: Ensure critical cloud activities are logged monitored and retained for investigation and audit
evidence_required: Logging configuration screenshot monitoring rule evidence and retention setting
review_notes: Logging enabled for production but retention period needs confirmation
remediation_action: Confirm cloud log retention settings and evidence centralised monitoring coverage
closure_evidence_required: Logging retention screenshot and monitoring validation record

risk_title: Sensitive data stored without clear classification
business_impact: Personal or sensitive data may be mishandled retained too long or accessed by unauthorised users
control_objective: Classify sensitive data assets and apply handling requirements based on sensitivity
evidence_required: Data classification register owner approval and handling procedure
review_notes: Register not yet uploaded for review
remediation_action: Complete data classification register for sensitive datasets

risk_title: Third-party vendor security evidence not consistently reviewed
business_impact: Vendor weaknesses may remain unidentified leading to compliance privacy or operational risk
control_objective: Assess vendor security posture before approval and maintain evidence for assurance
evidence_required: Vendor questionnaire security evidence risk rating and approval decision
evidence_name: Vendor security questionnaire for sample supplier
review_notes: Questionnaire provided with risk rating and approval notes
remediation_action: Standardise vendor evidence checklist and approval workflow
closure_evidence_required: Updated vendor review template and sample completed assessment

risk_title: Delayed remediation of high severity vulnerabilities
business_impact: Exploitable weaknesses may remain open beyond acceptable risk tolerance
control_objective: Track high severity vulnerabilities through ownership due date remediation and closure validation
evidence_required: Vulnerability scan remediation ticket and closure validation evidence
review_notes: Ticket exists but closure validation scan is missing
remediation_action: Validate high severity vulnerability remediation with follow-up scan
closure_evidence_required: Post-remediation scan result and closure approval

risk_title: Unclear ownership for security control evidence
business_impact: Audit evidence may be incomplete inconsistent or difficult to defend during assurance review
control_objective: Maintain clear traceability from control requirement to evidence owner status and review date
evidence_required: Evidence register control owner status and quality review notes
review_notes: Clear mapping between controls owners evidence status and review notes
remediation_action: Review evidence register monthly and flag incomplete evidence
closure_evidence_required: Reviewed evidence register and quality notes

risk_title: Weak change traceability for security-relevant system updates
business_impact: Security-related changes may be difficult to verify approve or roll back
control_objective: Ensure security-relevant changes are reviewed approved tested and traceable
evidence_required: Change ticket approval testing evidence and rollback plan
review_notes: Approval recorded but rollback evidence is missing
remediation_action: Add rollback evidence requirement to security change workflow
closure_evidence_required: Updated change checklist and sample approved change

risk_title: Cloud storage exposure due to misconfiguration
business_impact: Public or overly broad access may expose confidential or regulated data
control_objective: Prevent public or overly broad access to sensitive cloud storage
evidence_required: Storage policy screenshot access review and public access block confirmation
evidence_name: Cloud storage public access block screenshot
review_notes: Shows public access block enabled for target storage assets
remediation_action: Review storage permissions and confirm public access restrictions
closure_evidence_required: Access review and public access block confirmation

risk_title: Incident response procedures not fully evidenced
business_impact: Response actions may be inconsistent during incidents and difficult to evidence after the event
control_objective: Ensure incident response procedures are current tested and evidenced
evidence_required: Playbook review record tabletop exercise notes and action tracker
review_notes: Playbook review evidence not yet provided
remediation_action: Conduct incident response playbook review and document actions
closure_evidence_required: Playbook review notes and action tracker

risk_title: Privacy review gaps for new data processing activities
business_impact: New processing activities may proceed without adequate DPIA style review or risk treatment
control_objective: Assess privacy risk for new data processing activities and document treatment decisions
evidence_required: DPIA checklist data flow review risk decision and approval record
review_notes: DPIA style checklist exists but treatment decision requires sign off
remediation_action: Add sign-off step to privacy impact review workflow
closure_evidence_required: Signed privacy impact review and risk treatment decision
